The last unit test failed again in SPD in something completely
unrelated to the pull request:

http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Math%20Pull%20Request%20-%20Tests%20-%20Unit/124/

pull request.

test/unit/math/mix/mat/fun/mdivide_left_spd_test.cpp:506

Actual: it throws a different type.

The test passes on my machine using g++ -O3.

- Bob
